text: People make every decision that matters. They decide every requirement, fork and statement, and ratify every one-way door and every call the owner would want a say in. A coding agent's two-way calls, made while it carries out ratified work, are recorded as decided, as D-0022 has it, and stand only until the owner reverses them. SPEC's principle and docs/PRD.md say this in place of "a person makes every decision", which those decided calls had made untrue (D-0048, #372).
